description: This file defines the ConfigNamesMapper class, a core component in Drupal's configuration translation module. It manages route handling, configuration names, language codes, and translation operations for configuration entities.

classes.name: ConfigNamesMapper
classes.description: A base implementation for mapping configuration names to routes and managing multilingual configuration translation in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ConfigNamesMapper with dependencies such as route provider, config factory, locale manager, and event dispatcher.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class using a service container.

methods.name: setRouteCollection
methods.description: Sets the route collection for route management.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the mapper, translated.

methods.name: getBaseRouteName
methods.description: Returns the name of the base route.

methods.name: getBaseRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns parameters for the base route, default empty.

methods.name: getBaseRoute
methods.description: Retrieves the base route object from the route collection or provider.

methods.name: processRoute
methods.description: Placeholder for processing routes, can be overridden.

methods.name: getBasePath
methods.description: Returns the internal path of the base route.

methods.name: getOverviewRouteName
methods.description: Constructs the route name for the configuration overview.

methods.name: getOverviewRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns parameters for the overview route.

methods.name: getOverviewRoute
methods.description: Creates the overview route object.

methods.name: getOverviewPath
methods.description: Returns the internal path for the overview route.

methods.name: getAddRouteName
methods.description: Constructs the route name for adding configuration translations.

methods.name: getAddRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns parameters for the add route, including language code.

methods.name: getAddRoute
methods.description: Creates the add route object.

methods.name: getEditRouteName
methods.description: Constructs the route name for editing configuration translations.

methods.name: getEditRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns parameters for the edit route.

methods.name: getEditRoute
methods.description: Creates the edit route object.

methods.name: getDeleteRouteName
methods.description: Constructs the route name for deleting configuration translations.

methods.name: getDeleteRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns parameters for the delete route.

methods.name: getDeleteRoute
methods.description: Creates the delete route object.

methods.name: getConfigNames
methods.description: Returns the list of configuration names managed by this mapper.

methods.name: addConfigName
methods.description: Adds a configuration name to the list.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of this mapper for ordering.

methods.name: populateFromRouteMatch
methods.description: Populates the mapper's language code from route parameters and dispatches an event.

methods.name: getTypeLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for this type of configuration.

methods.name: getLangcode
methods.description: Returns the language code, ensuring only one language is managed.

methods.name: getLangcodeFromConfig
methods.description: Extracts the language code from a specific configuration, defaults to 'en'.

methods.name: setLangcode
methods.description: Sets the language code for the mapper.

methods.name: getConfigData
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration data for all managed configs.

methods.name: hasSchema
methods.description: Checks if all configs have schemas.

methods.name: hasTranslatable
methods.description: Checks if any configs are translatable.

methods.name: hasTranslation
methods.description: Checks if configs have translation for a given language.

methods.name: getTypeName
methods.description: Returns the type name, e.g., 'Settings'.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Returns available operations, such as 'Translate'.

methods.name: getContextualLinkGroup
methods.description: Returns contextual link group, default null.
